evals.name: clinic-first-run
evals.prompt: I scaffolded Clinic but declined the scripts. The backend starts; the browser has nothing to open. What should I do before designing intake?
evals.expected_output: Finish frontend setup without recreating Clinic and verify the starter's real visible result before modeling intake.
assertions: Uses the generated package-manager selection to install dependencies and launch Vite.
Checks local infrastructure and verifies a demo registration appears in the list; does not invent an intake feature.
